title: French supermarkets suffer fridge shutdown after 'unprecedented' cyberattack
summary: Major French supermarket chains were hit by an unprecedented cyberattack that forced them to shut down refrigeration systems, causing significant disruption to food storage and retail operations across the country.
problem_solved: This article reports on a cybersecurity incident rather than solving a problem; it highlights the vulnerability of critical infrastructure to cyberattacks.
why_valuable: Demonstrates the real-world consequences of cyberattacks on essential services and serves as a warning about the security risks of connected IoT devices in the food supply chain.
